verdict.rationale: WezTerm keeps its configuration as a plain-text Lua file (.wezterm.lua) that users report syncing and diffing across machines, and it can be read from beside the executable for portable use. Its own CLI `get-text` can dump pane and scrollback content, which a hands-on probe confirmed. There is no documented 'export all data' capability or exit guidance, so coverage of the full story is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented comprehensive data-export or migration feature, first-party docs on open-format portability of all stored state (e.g. scrollback and session persistence), and evidence of leaving or migrating to another tool.
